restructures.reason: Law establishing Halabja Governorate (قانون استحداث محافظة حلبجة) passed by the Council of Representatives on 2025-04-14, ratified by presidential decree on 2025-04-29 and published in the Official Gazette on 2025-05-05; Federal Supreme Court challenges rejected. OCHA COD-AB v01 still lists Halabja as a district of Sulaymaniyah, so the OCHA district and its four sub-districts move unchanged under a new governorate. Federal sources list the sub-districts as Sirwan, Khurmal, Biyara and Bamo; OCHA has Biyara, Khurmal, Markaz Halabja and Shahrazur, so the placement of Shahrazur is unconfirmed and Sirwan/Bamo have no OCHA geometry. No ISO 3166-2 code is confirmed by ISO (Wikidata lists IQ-HA), so isoCode stays null.
